description: Get the link for the user to subscribe to Schedulala or manage their existing billing. Use this when a call fails because a Schedulala subscription is required (quota_exceeded with an upgrade_url, or the sandbox plan), or when the user asks about upgrading or managing their plan. Payment always happens on schedulala.com / Stripe in the browser, never in this chat.
name: get_upgrade_link
title: Get Subscribe / Billing Link
